kurz: Very soft-cooked chickpeas, sesame paste and lemon become a smooth, airy emulsion.
bild_im_kopf: Like a down pillow made of chickpeas: the finer and airier, the softer.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Cook soaked chickpeas with a pinch of baking soda until almost falling apart
schluesselmomente.warum: [[natron|Baking soda]] loosens the cell walls and skins, which would otherwise stay grainy.
The sesame paste first thickens, then turns creamy: water and fat combine.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Add the chickpeas while still warm and blend for a long time
schluesselmomente.warum: Warm, they are softer and break down more finely.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Whip with a little iced water
schluesselmomente.warum: The water loosens the mixture and makes it pale and fluffy.
